Commentary.Commentary: So, that is it from this game. Ireland have qualified for sure. Who will be the ones to join them from this group? It is going to be one of Bahrain or UAE and the two are battling it out. We have two semi-final games coming up on 22nd February 2022. Both the games will begin at 3:30 pm IST (10:00 am GMT). Do join us early for the buildup! We bid adieu for now. Goodbye and take care!

Josh Little is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH. He says that he did not start the tournament well, but he is happy to perform today. Mentions that the wicket was assisting the bowlers and he is happy he could chip in. States that hopefully they can come out with a better performance in their upcoming games.

Andy Balbirnie the skipper of Ireland, says that they are really happy with the win, and the bowlers did well today. Mentions that it was a complete team performance this time. States that all the bowlers were very good, happy with the way they bowled today. Concludes, that they are just happy to win and looking forward to the next game.

Venkatraman Ganesan the skipper of Germany, says that toss was crucial, and the wicket was tacky, and they did not start well, they should have posted at least 130. Mentions that Ireland came out all guns firing, and unfortunately, they were on the receiving end. States that Faisal Mubashir played an excellent knock. Concludes by saying that they did pick up 3 wickets which was good and now they have to put their best foot forward in the remaining games.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

It was a complete performance from the Irish in an important game. Their bowlers led from the front and bundled Germany out for a low score. Their batters then had to knock it off in around 16 overs and have done so with ease.

Ireland have done their job then! They had to chase this down within 16 overs and have done so. They started off slowly but Andy Balbirnie and Paul Stirling stepped on the accelerator. When they were batting it seemed the game would end in the 11th over but a few wickets fell in the middle overs but still, they have managed to chase it down below the 16th over.
FOUR! Harry Tector finishes this off in style! A fuller ball, outside off. Harry  Tector drives it past cover for a boundary. Ireland win by 7 wickets!
Good-length delivery, outside off. Lorcan Tucker taps it towards cover and scampers through to the end. The fielder there has a shy at the bowler's end, but misses. An overthrow is taken! Two taken!
Length again, outside off. Harry Tector pushes it towards third man for a single. Ireland are 3 runs away now!
On a length, outside off. Harry Tector taps it towards point. Dot ball!
FOUR! Nicely done! A shorter ball, on middle. Harry Tector pulls it towards deep mid-wicket. The fielder there runs to his right, dives, but fails to stop the ball. Boundary!
Good-length delivery, around middle. Lorcan Tucker knocks it towards long on for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Lorcan Tucker lifts it towards mid off. The fielder there collects it on the bounce.
Shorter ball, around middle. Lorcan Tucker tucks it towards square leg for a single. Ireland are 9 runs away!
Loopy ball, very full around off. Harry Tector knocks it down to long off and rotates the strike!
Slower through the air now, full and outside off. Lorcan Tucker pushes it towards point for a single.
Loopy ball, outside off. Lorcan Tucker taps it towards third man. Single taken!
Fuller ball again, around off. Harry Tector drives and gets an inside edge towards long on for a single.
Fuller ball, on middle. Lorcan Tucker works it away towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
On middle, defended.
Two more! On middle, this is worked with soft hands through mid-wicket for two.
FOUR! Swept nicely! On middle, this is hit behind square on the leg side.
Another run as this is nudged on the leg side.
On middle, this is worked through square leg for one.

OUT! Taken! The man who was looking to end it early falls. He continues to look to find the fence. The bowler smartly tosses it up outside off, this one lands and spins away. Delany looks to go big over long off but ends up slicing it towards the man there and it is taken.
Commentary.Howout: c Fayaz Nasseri b Muslim Ashraf

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller ball, outside off. Gareth Delany drives it past cover for a single.
Shorter ball, around middle. Harry Tector tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Fuller ball, around middle and off. Harry Tector reverse-sweeps this over the fielder at short third man. Two runs taken!
Slower through the air, full and outside off. Gareth Delany shuffles across and sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! WOW! A fuller ball, on middle. Gareth Delany dances down the pitch and smashes this over long off for a biggie!
Shorter ball, on middle. Harry Tector flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller, outside off. Harry Tector drives it past cover for a single. End of a successful over by Muslim Ashraf!
Quicker and shorer, on middle. Gareth Delany tucks it towards mid-wicket and rotates the strike!
Fuller now, outside off. Gareth Delany pushes this to cover.
Shorter again, outside off. Harry Tector cuts it towards point for a single. He gets off the mark!

OUT! Quick wickets for Germany! This time it's Paul Stirling who goes back to the hut! A shorter balll, outside off. Paul Stirling stays in the crease and tries to cut this away past short third man, but the ball goes off the top edge, towards Faisal Mubashir at short third man who pouches it safely. Ireland are now 2 down!
Commentary.Howout: c Faisal Mubashir b Muslim Ashraf

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter ball, around middle. Gareth Delany tucks it towards square leg for a single.
fuller ball, around middle. Gareth Delany eases it down to long on for a single.

OUT! CAUGHT! Germany finally get the breakthrough! It's the big wicket of Andy Balbirnie! Slower through the air this time, full and around off. Andy Balbirnie makes room and lifts it over towards deep cover. Dieter Klein is perfectly placed out there, he takes an easy catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Dieter Klein b Venkatraman Ganesan

Commentary.Commentary: Short once again, on middle. Paul Stirling stays back and knocks it down to long on for a single.
Shorter this time, around middle. Paul Stirling pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Full again, on middle. Andy Balbirnie eases it down to long on. Single taken!
Slower through the air, fuller ball, on middle. Paul Stirling sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy ball, full and outside off. Paul Stirling taps it towards cover and takes a single. He retains the strike,
Tosses it up, full and on middle. Paul Stirling leans and defends it out.
Quicker one, outside off. Paul Stirling blocks it out.
SIX! High and handsome! A fuller ball, on middle. Paul Stirling steps down and tonks it high over long on for a biggie!
Fuller ball, on middle. Paul Stirling leans and blocks it out.
Shorter ball, on middle. Andy Balbirnie tucks it towards square leg for a single.
A full toss, on the pads. Paul Stirling misses his flick and gets hit on the pads. Dot to the over! Ireland are 54/0 at the end of the Powerplay!
Fuller ball, around middle. Paul Stirling steps down and drives it to the fielder at cover.
FOUR! Justin Broad serves a shorter one now, on middle. Paul Stirling pulls it past square leg for a boundary. Runs are flowing for Ireland at the moment!
Fuller in length, down the leg side. Andy Balbirnie backs away and flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single. 50 up for Ireland!
Tad shorter, on middle. Andy Balbirnie presents the full face of the bat and blocks it out.
Fuller ball now, around middle. Paul Stirling tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Justin Broad comes to bowl now.
Fuller and on off, this is pushed to covers.
On middle, kept out.
A dot! On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
FOUR MORE! Goes short again and Andy has no problem in rocking back and pulling it through backward square leg. Raining boundaries at the moment.
SIX! They are in a hurry to end this. Balbirnie steps out and lifts this high and long over mid off for a biggie.
FOUR! Ireland now scoring freely. On middle, this is timed wonderfully past the bowler and into the fence.
Dylan Alexander Blignaut comes into the attack now.
FOUR! Up and over! Room on offer outside off. Stirling lifts it over covers and bags a boundary.
On the stumps, kept out yet again.
Flatter and on middle, defended.
SIX! Bang! That is a big hit. Shorter this time, Stirling pulls it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
FOUR! This should get him going. Tossed up on off, this is lofted over covers for a boundary.
Flatter and on middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Stirling is kind of struggling here! Length and outside off, he is beaten again as he tries to defend.
Swing and a miss! Fuller and outside off, Stirling looks to go downtown but misses.
A single now as this is nudged on the leg side.
SIX! There is no stopping that. Andy is dealing in biggies. Shorter and on middle, this is pulled over the square leg fence.
Good stop again! Short and outside off, Balbirnie cuts it hard but to the left of point who dives and saves a boundary.
Good stop! Shorter and outside off, Andy hits it towards point. The fielder dives to his left and stops it.
Fires this outside off, Paul looks to drive but misses.
On middle, this is eased down to long on for one.
Outside off, AB chops it to point.
SIX! All the way. That is some way to get things going. Balbirnie brings out the slog sweep and he nails it over the mid-wicket fence.
On middle, this is pushed to cover.
Flatter and on off, this is guided to point.
Ghulam Rasul Ahmadi will bowl from the other end.
A dot to end! A fine comeback by the bowler. Stirling advances. He looks to go over covers but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Good length again, Stirling keeps it out.
On off, blocked.
Good line, just outside off and on a length. Left alone.
Another one full and wide outside off, Stirling slashes at it but misses.
FOUR! Stirling is off the mark in style! Full and outside off, he drives it past cover and this one races away to the fence.
WIDE! Ireland are underway! This is well wide outside off. Left alone.
